_comment: Per-camera ODM start-line detector config. Tuned 2026-07-16 against the app's public branded frames. All positions are FRACTIONS of frame width/height so they are resolution-independent. NOTE: the relay pulls the camera SUB-stream, which may have a different field of view/sharpness than the frames this was tuned on. If the line is off, grab one sub-stream frame, drop it in odm_frames/ and re-tune with run_detect.py, then copy the values here.

color._comment: PIL HSV channels are 0-255 (H: 0 red, ~21 orange, ~42 yellow).

roi._comment: Sea band the buoy can appear in; excludes sky, beach, logos.

pole._comment: Foreground pole: line inner end (x,y) + a column to exclude.

swing_zone._comment: Gaussian prior on where the anchored buoy appears. cy is tight (fixed distance); cx wider (swings). Race officer would set this once by marking the swing area.

shape._comment: Blob gates. Areas are px normalised to 1920x1080. Aspect is height/width; thin streaks (pole/glint) are rejected.

_line_comment: Overlay appearance. line_color is RGB; line_opacity 0-1 (the line is drawn solid then the whole layer's alpha is scaled, so it reads as painted on the water). Live relay uses this default (green); the future start-video overlay will pass red before the start and green after.

smoother._comment: For live use only (a sequence of frames). Ignored for independent stills.
